text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — p99 latency > 5s for 6m on prod-west. SLO burn at 0.12. Page: ENG-ONCALL. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incident/PD-78901

pagerduty: PagerDuty auto-trigger: Incident PD-78901, escalation policy: eng-oncall. Trigger rule: p99_latency > 5s for 5m. Notifying on-call.

maya: ack'd. I'm on it. pulling dashboards now — https://console.redwood/inference/alerts/PD-78901

maya: quick summary: region=prod-west, model=redwood/open-3b, no recent rollout. traffic spike from client=analytics-batch. p99=6.4s, p95=1.2s.

sam: copy. can we short-circuit heavy requests to a quantized fallback (open-3b-q4) while we triage?

alex: will do two things: reduce batching window + scale replicas on the dedicated pool. executing:
```
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deploy/inference-worker-west
kubectl -n prod scale deploy/inference-worker-west --replicas=12
```

ops-bot: autoscaler note: requested scale to 12 replicas. GPU quota available: 9 free GPUs. Starting new pods.

leila: support context — customers A123 and B234 reporting 504s on long-context calls. ticket refs: https://support.redwood/t/3489

maya: routing rule patch going out to send requests with input_tokens > 2048 to open-3b-q4. applying now.

maya: ```
curl -X POST https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_OPS\" \
  -d '{"match":"input_tokens>2048","route":"open-3b-q4"}'
```

pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-78901 acknowledged by maya at 2026-03-10T15:12:34Z

sam: check KV cache hit rate — if cache thrash is happening that can spike tail latency. Can we increase cache size and warm prefixes for analytics-batch?

alex: bumping KV cache and warming keys now:
```
redis-cli -h kv-west CONFIG SET maxmemory 12gb
// warming: scan keys for analytics-batch and GET to populate
redis-cli -h kv-west --scan --pattern "analytics-batch:*" | xargs -n1 redis-cli -h kv-west GET
```

ops-bot: KV cache resize to 12GB succeeded. Warming job started (job id: warm-8792).

leila: monitoring update: p99 dropped to ~3.1s after routing + scale; p95 ~0.9s. 504s still present but tailing down.

maya: mitigation checklist — routing to q4 fallback live, scaled replicas, restarted workers, KV cache increased. continuing to observe for next 30m.

sam: we should identify root cause — so far looks like a single client spiking long-context traffic ~4x at 14:58Z. tagging for postmortem analysis.

leila: postmortem notes to collect: tail_latency_by_client, kv_cache_evictions, pod_cpu_temp, restart_count, client-retry-patterns.

ops-bot: Auto-escalation timer: 10m remaining before escalation to eng-sre. (Acknowledgement cancels escalation.)

maya: customer impact summary for handoff: long-context requests from analytics-batch caused increased retries and several 504s for customers A123/B234 for ~18 minutes. Mitigations: temporary routing to open-3b-q4, scaled replicas 7->12, KV cache increase to 12GB, worker restarts. No data loss. Incident doc: https://redwood.in/incidents/INC-2026-341

night-oncall: will take over in ~25m. I'll monitor SLOs and check for any reversion need. ping me if p99 > 5s again.

maya: handing off now — full log snippet, commands run, and checklist in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty: PD-78901 resolved by maya at 2026-03-10T15:48:10Z. Condition met: p99 < 2.5s for 10m. Closing alert.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-341 created and linked to PD-78901. Owner: maya. Severity: Sev-2.

leila: follow-ups (added to backlog): 1) rate-limit analytics-batch client, 2) add per-client tail latency alerting, 3) KV cache auto-scale rules, 4) run 5x long-context load test and validate autoscaler behavior.

sam: +1 on rate-limit and per-client alerting. I'll file a ticket and assign priority.

alex: note — one pod showed elevated memory pressure before restart (OOM spike). adding mem-pressure probe and better churn handling to avoid noisy restarts.

maya: thanks all. I'll draft the initial postmortem and reach out to affected customers with a summary and mitigation details.
